alex: Quick question — user story: tenant-level alert overrides global SLO notify. In the console we show both policies but not which one will run. Should the UI show an \"effective policy\" badge? cc @maria @jamal
maria: Yeah, we currently evaluate notify policies server-side; UI shows list, but not resolution. That confuses support.
jamal: From API side, we return matched_policies array. We could add effective_policy_id and resolution_trace. Would that be enough for the console?
tina: +1. Also need telemetry so we can backfill how often tenant overrides actually trigger. Suggest field `policy_resolution.path` with ordered ids.
alex: Example response shape I'm proposing:
```
{
  \"matched_policies\": [\"global-slo-5m\", \"tenant-override-123\"],
  \"effective_policy\": \"tenant-override-123\",
  \"resolution_trace\": [\"global-slo-5m -> fallback\", \"tenant-override-123 -> selected\"]
}
```
jamal: That works. Two asks: 1) make resolution deterministic (priority + explicit deny), 2) ensure preview API (`/v1/notify/preview`) returns the same effective_policy logic.
maria: UX: show a compact badge: \"Effective: tenant-override-123\" with hover to expand resolution_trace. Also expose a \"why this fired\" link to telemetry logs.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: notify-preview API patch -> canary at 10% at 2026-03-22T09:00Z
alex: For rollout: canary + telemetry sampling at 100% for matched policies only. That keeps noise low. Also add a console flag to toggle \"show experimental precedence\" per org.
jamal: One more: quota implications — if tenant override routes to a higher-fidelity notify (e.g., SMS), we need to ensure quota checks run after resolution. Otherwise billing mismatch.
maria: Agreed. Implementation plan: API returns effective_policy and post-resolution quota_check flag; console displays potential quota delta in preview card. I'll file a tiny RFC and mention in the rollout doc.
alex: Great — I'll update the API spec and drop the stub in #eng-platform tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
